description: Classic SEO audit of a page, weighted like a full SEO audit: technical (canonical, indexability, redirects, HTTPS/HSTS, security headers, mobile viewport, hreflang, 2 MB HTML limit, back-button hijacking), content and E-E-A-T trust signals, on-page (title, meta description, headings, internal links, anchor text), schema validation (parse errors, required properties, retired rich-result types), performance, images and AI search readiness. Returns a 0-100 score and prioritized issues with fixes.
name: audit_seo
title: Audit Google SEO health
